data.goal: Scene2DModule becomes a pure loader/unloader that populates sibling modules' registries — it no longer owns cameras, lights, or entities.

phases.name: Rename CameraModule -> Camera2DModule
phases.description: Rename class, files, kTypeId, all ModuleRef sites, all .diaapp manifests

phases.name: Create Light2DModule
phases.description: New module owning LightRegistry2D, following Camera2DModule pattern. Add to vcxproj and .diaapp manifests for Scene2DTestStage.

phases.name: Rewire Scene2DModule
phases.description: Remove owned registries/domain from Scene2DModule. Add ModuleRef<EntityModule>, ModuleRef<Camera2DModule>, ModuleRef<Light2DModule>. Build SceneLoadContext from their registries. Update .diaapp dependencies.

phases.name: Update consumers
phases.description: Scene2DTestStageModule and Scene2DTestDrawer access cameras/lights/entities from their owning modules directly. Update feature spec.

acceptance_criteria: A1: dia run cluichetest — Scene2DTestStage passes all 5 checkpoints
A2: dia run googletest — all existing tests pass
A3: Only one Entity::Domain instance in SimPU (EntityModule)
A4: Only one CameraRegistry2D instance in SimPU (Camera2DModule)
A5: Only one LightRegistry2D instance in SimPU (Light2DModule)
A6: Scene-loaded cameras visible to PickingModule/VisualDebuggerModule via Camera2DModule
A7: Scene2DModule has no include for Domain.h, CameraRegistry2D.h, or LightRegistry2D.h
A8: CameraModule name does not appear anywhere in code or manifests
